about: Golden conversations for E1 and E2 (plan section 8, A13). Each runs on the live rig's farm: the trained feed at 1x with the HVAC supply-fan fault injected, every node's manual approved by a fixture. 'must' terms must appear in the reply (case-insensitive), 'must_not' terms must not. Every answered or fallback reply must state its farm time.
